blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — A 33-year-old man was shot dead while walking along a road at Purok 4, Sitio Pantaron, Barangay Banlag here on Saturday evening. Initial investigation showed that the incident occurred at approximately 7:00 p.m. when the victim was using his cellphone while walking home. An unidentified suspect approached and shot him three times. The victim sustained gunshot wounds to thechest, abdomen and thigh. Investigators have identified a person of interest, believed to be the former live-in partner of the victim’s current partner. Lt Col.
